Name: Shell Corrosion
Counterplay: Make layer loss visible. Do not treat corrosion as universal defence bypass or as an automatic way to stop Membrane regeneration.
Effect: Corrosion erodes or removes Shell layers. Lost layers do not regenerate during the encounter.
Role: Erodes finite Shell layers so later qualifying hits can reach the creature more effectively.
Trigger: Acid hits or sustained, explicitly corrosive exposure against a Shell-protected target.

Name: Propagation
Counterplay: Propagation is not automatic on every Fire hit. Limit each target to one propagation event per chain and prevent reaction-created fire from retriggering.
Effect: A single bounded propagation event transfers ignition to an eligible target or surface.
Role: Lets Fire spread only through a deliberately compatible setup.
Trigger: Ignition occurs near a susceptible target or explicitly flammable surface within a defined range.

Name: Interruption
Counterplay: Heavy actions and bosses may resist or require a poise threshold. Do not interrupt every enemy on every hit or create stun-lock.
Effect: Cancels or briefly delays the action.
Role: Disrupts a clearly telegraphed action during a valid interruption window.
Trigger: A qualifying Force/Static hit crosses the relevant threshold or hits an action with a vulnerable window.

Name: Fear
Counterplay: Fear applies only to Fear-tagged effects, not all Soul damage or every mental/resource effect. Specify duration and counterplay.
Effect: Applies one specified effect such as panic, retreat, hesitation, or a control penalty.
Role: Creates a defined morale or decision-making disruption.
Trigger: An attack explicitly tagged Fear applies to the target.

Name: Ignition
Counterplay: Reset or damp buildup after triggering. Cap repeat bursts and propagation; do not let reaction-created Fire loop.
Effect: Triggers one flare or burst; a separate explicit rule may allow one controlled propagation event.
Trigger: Visible, bounded Burn buildup reaches its defined threshold.

Name: Status Buildup
Counterplay: Keep buildup and decay readable; cap stacks and avoid hidden multi-step recipes. A missed application does not apply its attached status, while existing statuses and hazards persist.
Effect: At a defined threshold, applies or upgrades one specified status.
Role: Tracks progress toward a clearly defined status threshold.
Trigger: Repeated qualifying hits or continued exposure from an explicitly tagged source.

Name: Possessed
Counterplay: Clear duration and visual tell; cooldown before it can repeat; elites turn for less time; bosses get a reduced version and are never fully controlled. Not Fear.
Effect: The enemy attacks and blocks its own side for a few seconds, then recovers.
Role: Mind control: turns one enemy against its mates.
Trigger: Soul build-up on the enemy reaches full.

Name: Poise Damage
Counterplay: Define threshold and recovery; elites and bosses may resist. Avoid stun-lock and avoid treating every Static hit as a guaranteed interrupt.
Effect: Builds toward a brief stagger or interruption, separate from health damage.
Role: Pressures an enemy's ability to maintain a stance or action.
Trigger: Qualifying Force impact or a Static hit with an explicit poise/interrupt component connects.

Name: Displacement / Knockback
Counterplay: Squishy may reduce physical impact and impulse; Membrane reduces knockback while active; heavy Force can knock a Shell layer loose. Mass, anchoring, and terrain matter.
Effect: Pushes or launches the target according to impact strength and resistance; collision payoffs occur only on actual collision.
Role: Changes position through applied physical momentum.

Name: Combustion
Counterplay: Do not treat Acid as inherently flammable or add a generic Acid + Fire explosion. Define ally/objective rules and show zone boundaries.
Effect: Produces one bounded burst or short-lived burning zone.
Role: Creates a local burst or temporary burning zone from a specifically flammable material or prepared hazard.
Trigger: A compatible flammable material or prepared hazard is ignited.

Name: Conductivity / Chain
Counterplay: Use a visible chain budget and conductivity requirements. A pool reaction is bounded to its visible area and one pulse; do not duplicate Fire propagation.
Effect: An arc jumps to a limited number of valid targets, or one pulse travels through a defined conductive pool.
Role: Rewards conductive links and clustered positioning with limited electrical chaining.
Trigger: Static hits an eligible target or explicitly conductive path.

Name: Hemorrhage
Counterplay: Cap stacks and define refresh/termination. Physical wound damage may be mitigated by physical defences, but Bleed ticks are not automatically reduced by Squishy or Shell.
Effect: Applies a defined Bleed duration and damage profile; a named finisher may consume the wound for one payoff.
Role: Turns a qualifying wound into capped ongoing blood loss.
Trigger: A qualifying wound or Blood effect applies Bleed.

Name: Adhesion
Counterplay: Do not make every hit a full root. Squishy and Shell do not inherently prevent adhesion; Dodge can avoid the applying hit but does not clear existing coating or patches.
Effect: Applies a modest slow/stick or creates a bounded, short-lived sticky patch according to the attack.
Role: Restricts movement and creates visible setup patches.
Trigger: An eligible target or surface is coated by Mucus.

Name: Exsanguination
Counterplay: Not a reward on every Blood tick. Prevent repeat-hit farming.
Effect: Grants a small, capped health/resource benefit.
Role: Turns a specific wound or Blood attack into limited extraction or sustain.
Trigger: A named attack hits a valid target or consumes a defined wound/bleed threshold.

Name: Burn
Counterplay: Leaving a burning zone stops further zone exposure, not an already-applied Burn. Squishy and Shell do not inherently resist heat/Burn; Membrane absorbs eligible direct damage but does not automatically prevent Burn or later zone exposure.
Effect: Applies capped damage over time and visible buildup toward the Ignition threshold.
Role: Creates sustained heat pressure and contributes to Ignition buildup.
Trigger: A Fire hit or continued exposure applies Burn under that attack's rules.
